doctrine_full: Falcon is the live perception layer. Falcon detects setups in any regime — including bad ones (architect ratified 2026-05-03). Falcon is NON-EXECUTING BY DESIGN. Falcon may produce live observations consumed by Helios / Solo / NEO; broker integration is forbidden by lane discipline.

system.name: Falcon
system.runs_as: ShadowDaemon — `python3 -m falcon.daemon.main` — current deployment uses 'shadow' label which means 'non-execution path'. The 'shadow' name is a legacy term for what is correctly described as PERCEPTION-ONLY by design (architect 2026-05-03).
system.deployment_status: LIVE PERCEPTION — emitting signals consumed by Helios V3 daemon, NEO, Solo. Production-grade by reliability of observations, not by broker integration.
system.cycle_cadence: One cycle per M5 candle boundary (300s)

01_purpose: Detect potential trade setups across 18 plugin strategies and emit structured fire/decline records every M5 cycle. A FIRE is a STRUCTURED OBSERVATION that a known setup may exist — it is NOT a trade instruction. Falcon does not align (Helios), does not veto risk (ARES), does not size positions, does not execute (Agent Smith / broker). Pure observation layer that detects regardless of regime; downstream layers decide whether action is appropriate.

database.helios_strategy_signals: ONE ROW PER STRATEGY PER CYCLE — Solo + Helios V3 unified read feed. Both fires (fired=1) and declines (fired=0). Columns: cycle_id, instrument, timestamp, strategy_id, strategy_name, strategy_version, fired, confidence (0-10 scaled), adjusted_confidence (= confidence × R2D2 health_score), health_score, health_status, health_source, health_as_of, direction (LONG/SHORT/NULL), phase, key_level, invalidation_level, entry_price, sl_price, tp1_price, tp2_price, reason_codes (JSON array), evidence (JSON), gate_trace (JSON array — v1 strategies only), regime_context (JSON — includes ARES snapshot for explainability), config_version_hash, source_data_hash. Outcome columns populated by maintenance/outcome_resolver.py (wick_aware). NAMING NOTE: 'helios_strategy_signals' is misleading legacy — this table is FALCON-OWNED. Helios reads only. See r2d2:blueprint:forbidden_merges:v1.1 rule 8.
database.falcon_decisions: ONE ROW PER CYCLE — outcome-scoped. PK=decision_id ({cycle_ts}Z:{instrument}:{mode}). outcome ENUM: TRADE | DECLINE | FAULT.
database.falcon_pulse_proposal_log: RAW STRATEGY TRUTH — every proposal AND every decline regardless of selector state. Independent data source for health aggregation.
database.falcon_pulse_strategy_health: Nightly aggregate per strategy×instrument: health_score (0-100), health_status, drift_score, win_rate, expectancy.
database.falcon_fault_log: Persisted FaultContract rows. severity DEBUG..CRITICAL. recovery_action ENUM: CONTINUE | DECLINE | HALT | EXCLUDE_PROPOSAL | RETRY.

06_meaning_of_a_strategy_fire.what_it_means: Worker has reached TRIGGERED phase and all internal gates passed. A fire is RECORDED but DOES NOT execute. Fires aggregate via Helios V3 into ALIGNMENT STATE. The ALIGNMENT STATE is read by trader-gate-compositor + Solo who decide whether action is appropriate.
06_meaning_of_a_strategy_fire.scaling: Worker emits confidence in 0-1. Signal feed scales to 0-10 for helios_strategy_signals.confidence column.

adjusted_confidence.formula: = confidence × health_multiplier (where multiplier = LINEAR_DAMPEN_ONLY_V1: max(MIN_CLAMP, min(MAX_CLAMP, 0.5 + health_score × 0.5)))
adjusted_confidence.current_state: R2D2 health envelope shipping is partial; many strategies use TEMPORARY_BRIDGE / UNTRUSTED status which yields HEALTH_UNTRUSTED_MULTIPLIER. This DOES NOT BLOCK confluence — Helios V3 has STRUCTURAL CONFLUENCE today (architect correction 2026-05-03). Health weights upgrade structural confluence to RELIABILITY-WEIGHTED confluence.

07_meaning_of_a_decline.what_it_means: Strategy did not satisfy a gate this cycle. Setup may still progress in future cycles (state machines persist). Declines are observational, not failures. CRITICAL: declines are how we observe non-firing strategies — essential for health monitoring.
07_meaning_of_a_decline.ares_does_not_cause_decline: Per architect doctrine 2026-05-03: Falcon detects in any regime, even bad. If a strategy declines despite ARES_BLOCK, the decline reason is the strategy's own gate logic, not ARES. ARES context is snapshot for explainability, not a Falcon-level veto. STATUS: needs verification audit (Q4 / new check) — gatekeeper TODO.

08_what_falcon_is_forbidden_to_decide: Whether to execute a trade (Solo / Matt judge; Agent Smith executes when authorised)
Whether multiple strategies align (Helios V3 reduces)
Whether risk is acceptable (ARES authors gate state; trader-gate-compositor enforces at execution layer)
Whether ARES state should change (Falcon snapshots, never writes)
Order placement / broker calls (ZERO execution code; tripwire-grade)
Outcome ground-truth substitution (outcome_resolver wick_aware is canonical; R2D2 audits disagreements only)
